'''Ben Blanton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[April 2000 Knoxville tournament]] on 16 April 2000, according to Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d535">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ knoxville-tn-4-16-00], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
